blocked.name: The Frank Liberty Tree (bur oak, 328 South Monroe Avenue, Old Northeast Kansas City)
blocked.reason: Dead/removed. Approximately 250-year-old bur oak, certified a bicentennial Liberty Tree by Missouri's governor and Kansas City's mayor in 1976, was cut down in January 2026 after developing an advanced root fungus that made it unsafe. Confirmed by multiple 2025-12/2026-01 local news sources (KCUR, FOX4KC, KSHB, KCTV5), including a community farewell event before removal. Do not ship as a collectible entry per the never-publish-a-dead-tree rule; kept here only as a record of a rejected candidate.
